name: house-model-ritual-v1
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: a photorealistic luxury fragrance campaign image for the After Bells House page, portrait 2:3.
Primary request: an elegant adult European woman actually applying perfume to her neck, caught in a quiet, natural gesture.
Input image 1 is ONLY a product identity reference sheet. Use its FRONT-VIEW Amber Hour bottle design. Do not copy its collage layout or printed captions. The model is a new fictional person, not the person in any earlier generated image.
Model: a beautiful adult woman around 30 years old with natural fair skin, light hazel eyes, light blonde hair loosely gathered into a low bun with a few real stray strands, understated editorial makeup and realistic skin texture. She wears a black tailored blazer over an ivory silk blouse with a simple modest open neckline that leaves the side of her neck accessible. No large jewellery or accessories. Her head is tilted very gently upward and turned in a three-quarter profile toward the soft window light; her eyes are softly closed in a moment of calm. A self-possessed, intimate perfume ritual, not a beauty catalogue pose.
Action and physical accuracy are essential: she holds one UNCAPPED perfume bottle upright in her right hand, about 12 cm from the side of her neck, below her jaw. Her fingers grip the lower bottle naturally; thumb supports the opposite side; her index fingertip is pressing DOWN on the small gold atomizer actuator. The atomizer nozzle points toward her neck. A very fine, short, almost translucent mist travels from the nozzle to her neck. The bottle remains vertical, not tipped toward her mouth. Do not spray through a cap. The removed ornate cap is outside the crop, never attached to the spraying bottle. Only one bottle. No duplicated hands or fingers.
Bottle invariants from the reference: thick faceted clear rectangular glass, substantial transparent base, amber liquid and the ORIGINAL very small gold flakes mostly resting at the bottom. Polished cylindrical gold neck with a realistic exposed gold spray actuator. The thin square gold FRONT label is visible at a slight angle toward the camera, with two fine dark border rules and accurately printed black words "AFTER BELLS" and "AMBER HOUR", with a tiny diamond between two rules. No label or sticker on any narrow SIDE surface. Natural hand-sized perfume bottle with believable proportions, not a giant product.
Scene: a quiet contemporary interior with a warm grey stone window reveal and deep brown plaster background. Soft daylight from the left gently lights her cheek, hand and the glass. Espresso shadows, ivory silk, black wool and warm amber perfume; balanced real skin tones, no orange colour cast. A sophisticated photographic fragrance advertisement with believable contact, realistic anatomy and glass refraction.
Composition: waist-up portrait, full head and hair visible. Head begins about 12% down the frame, face is within the central 70% width, perfume hand and bottle clearly visible around the middle of the image. Keep head, nozzle, bottle, hand and neck action safely inside the central 75% height so a 4:5 crop also works. Space around the shoulders and head. The viewer must immediately understand that she is applying fragrance.
Photorealistic medium-format fashion photography, fine individual hair, subtle fabric weave, natural pores, restrained retouching, crisp eye/eyelash and hand/bottle detail. No waxy skin, no exaggerated mist cloud, no sparkle, no glow, no fantasy gold particles, no extra props, no other people. No text overlay, graphic frame, watermark or interface. One unified editorial photograph.
